AD8a_AD9_disclosure_verbatim:
> The dev pilot showed the original 12-date confirmation design was underpowered (binding F4 STOP, 7a78a8f). Before
> any confirmation sample was decoded or any confirmation noise statistic was computed, the confirmation set was
> enlarged to all 60 eligible dates and the power-required cells were corrected to exclude the theta0 falsification
> cells (AD8a; enlargement by AD9). Access precision: the earlier design-stage scoping run (MS 3996faf) downloaded
> and SHA-256-hashed all 190 Rnoise files, including the 60 later-confirmation units, and read their headers with
> `preload=False`; no confirmation sample was decoded and no confirmation noise statistic was computed.

budgets.N_max_rule: floor(P / 1.1), continuous count ceiling, not a discrete N-candidate
budgets.P_rule: minimum training pool across all 12 dev units before gates; Nstar_A=floor(P/5), Nstar_B=max(5*N_min_grid,Nstar_A/2)
budgets.reference_effective_count_label: stride-T count is an arithmetic heuristic, not an estimated independent count
budgets.rounding: round half up; de-duplicate; omit out-of-budget N, never move a predicted crossing into range

confirmation_seed_index: 12 + index in sorted complete60 confirmation list; indices12..71; no cohort selection or analysis-order rule

cell_definitions.10: eval smallest full Sref eigenmode variance x8, descriptive
cell_definitions.11: eval largest full Sref eigenmode variance x8, descriptive
cell_definitions.12: eval top population full eigenmode variance x1.5, descriptive
cell_definitions.2: eval own Sref top10 variance x1.5
cell_definitions.3: eval own Sref bottom50 variance x1.5
cell_definitions.4: eval own Sref middle40 variance x1.5
cell_definitions.5: eval smallest spatial Sref eigenmode variance x8 at every time
cell_definitions.6: eval largest spatial Sref eigenmode variance x8 at every time

controls.claim_rules: G2 null L1..L6 C0: CP upper <=.05 (6 claims), G1/singular failure counts as exclusion; G2 detection L1,L2,L4 C1..C6: CP lower >=.90 (18), success requires G1 pass AND G2 failure, G1/singular failure is NON-DETECTION; full n2400, no deletions; L5/C0 is null endpoint; L7 entirely descriptive
controls.failure_rule: any endpoint fails -> STOP and return to design; no tuning, rerun or selective pooling
controls.fit: AR10 Yule-Walker from ref-role native-to-decimated lag moments 0..19 within active ref blocks only; spatial partial trace trace C; stable positive innovation required, otherwise STOP; no model search

law_definitions.2: fitted spatial factor and stationary AR10 within each full block, independent blocks
law_definitions.5: L2 plus equal-offset block AR .75; C0 G2 null endpoint, all detection cells/other diagnostics descriptive
law_definitions.6: L2 plus chronological scan-third lognormal variance factors: top population 10% sd .2 and global sd .1
law_definitions.7: L2 plus block lognormal variance factors: both sd .1, descriptive

E1.power_rule: AD8a/AD9 four reference sign cells; strict family34 t half-width < half abs prediction; nine-date R50 SD one-sided80% upper limit; n=8..60; n_min18; no further remedy; below18 passing confirmation dates STOP/no claim

G1.failure: exclude unit; do not change fixed geometry

gates.G4: R1 g4: Kronecker flip-flop vs unshrunk Sref, descriptive
gates.G5: old g5_mardia on pooled training windows, descriptive; IID z is not inferential

artifact.amplitude_baseline: per-channel whole-scan median; screen only, FIR input unchanged
artifact.exceedance_rule: any abs(raw - channel whole-scan median) >= max_abs_tesla, any raw step >= max_step_tesla or any raw nonfinite -> exclude whole unit; no window repair
artifact.stage: selected magnetometers at native rate before filtering, entire scan

geometry.rule: nearest Euclidean sensor centres to target in MNE device frame (FIFF 1), ties by channel name; retain 12, order names lexically; pinned dev header geometry only

author_decisions_pending: AD1: Exclude G1 failures directly instead of R1 data-driven channel-drop retest, preserving fixed geometry.
AD2: Absolute artifact screen (500 pT amplitude,50 pT native sample step,any exceedance excludes); new thresholds require author adoption before decoding.
AD3: E1 >=9/12 and confirmation target first12 ascending eligible confirmation dates; minimum8 with R1 power rule, no replacement or expansion.

AD4: Whole full-block-without-replacement learning/calibration sampling, independent uniform cyclic rotation per selected block; wrapped partial draws are two observed segments; nominal IID PZ2 retains dependence limitation.
AD5: Continuous N ceiling floor(P/1.1)=1010, A-grid maximum888, mhi512; PZ4 high-m change; preserve10% margins instead of R1 training1600.
AD6: Continuous-scan controls use 10s block AR and scan-thirds instead of stimulus gaps and runs; no G3 claims; artifact screen is operational and has no calibrated false-exclusion claim.
AD7: C12,T6 and scaled filtered bases change dimensions/time support; keep fixed theta/SNR instead of searching a more favourable setting.

inference.PZ1: B_dagger zero at theta0 and monotone over fixed theta grid, numerical tolerance 1e-9; analytic per unit
inference.PZ2: reference contrast negative below and positive above in-range Nstar interval with decided intervals; no claim for out-of-grid crossing
inference.PZ3: theta0 no decided positive reference contrast
inference.PZ4: estimated-minus-reference contrast negative at m256 for both estimators, point estimate nearer zero at mhi
inference.PZ5: isotropic arm no decided negative contrast
inference.contrast: product clean risk minus unrestricted clean risk
inference.interval: Bonferroni simultaneous Student t across date means, df included dates minus 1; within-unit resampling whole blocks only
miss_reasons: serial dependence changes IID S4.3 coefficients
fixed point-coil forward recipe only approximates physical fields

planning_defaults_author_to_confirm: PD1: Full 10 s blocks only, 4 s guards, 2 s edges and ref/train/cal/eval/train cycle; 6 blocks per sparse role and11 full train blocks; discard incomplete terminal block.
PD2: Extend T candidates to 8 and 6; choose T6, C12 by largest feasible T and ref stride-T >=8d heuristic; physical duration about59 ms.
PD3: Fixed device-coordinate sphere and two point-dipole templates; nearest vertex patch, no regression or source localization claim.
PD4: Reuse R1 population optimizers (64 total starts), two adaptive theta targets A/B plus four fixed theta rows; 50 D3-S references x6 rows.
PD5: 12 dev shapes x200 controls per law/cell; 24 claims at alpha .05/24, 168000 replicates; caps 6h at4 workers and8h at16 for D3-S.
PD6: SeedSequence([20261019,law,cell,sorted-dev-index,replicate]); separate cells90 D3-S and99 timing.
prediction_order: Per eligible passing date: qualify and construct unshrunk Sref; compute all four fixed and two adaptive rows; publish exact per-date pre_fit prediction bytes to MS origin/main in a commit strictly after the registration tag; before_fit must pass before any learning fit for that date.

reference.D3S_definition: R1 general_noise with same fixed physical signal and each simulated Sref; report delta=a_hat-D_W, Nstar under M=K+N_sim, trace(N_sim)/d next to observed m_train; descriptive only
reference.inflation_bracket: no borrowed numeric R1 bracket: report simulated quantiles from D3-S, and stride-T Wishart heuristic separately; neither adjusts primary prediction
reference.kind: unshrunk divisor-n ref-role covariance centred at ref mean; no shrinkage or ridge

reporting_rule: Report every outcome, exclusion, unavailable cell, diagnostic and STOP; never replace exclusions or alter family34.

signal.adaptive_failure: report unavailable; no new signal or geometry search
signal.basis_rule: R1 filtered g,gprime,gsecond; native grid centred at t=0 over +/- 4 s, native 1-40 FIR, take t=0,20,...,100 original samples; QR sign fixed; source 2 raw family projected off source 1 then QR

forward.model: Sarvas homogeneous sphere, point magnetometers; sensor centres and loc[9:12] normals in device coordinates, no reference coils
forward.normalization: each spatial field unit norm; fix largest absolute entry positive; no orthogonalization

signal.trace_normalization: one variance scale at theta=0 per unit; unchanged across theta

supersession: AD8a excludes theta0 falsification cells from power requirement only; all15 reference cells remain in family34
AD9 supersedes AD3 cohort/n_min rule and no-expansion clause; all60 dates, R50, n8..60, n_min18
F4 STOP7a78a8f remains binding for the earlier12-date design; correction addendum supersedes historical access wording

windows.block_samples_rule: floor(block_seconds * fs); first ceil(guard_seconds * fs) samples of EVERY full block discarded; incomplete terminal block discarded entirely
windows.edge_samples_rule: ceil(edge_seconds * fs) removed at each end
windows.grid: each active block starts at block_start + guard; never restart the grid
windows.resampling: equal-length full active role blocks only; uniform block permutation without replacement, independent uniform cyclic rotation of each block windows; concatenate and truncate final rotated block; wrapped partial draws are two observed segments, not physically contiguous; all eval windows fixed
